WFP spent about $500k too and was building off of several cycles of winning down ballot in Philly. Probably couldn’t have happened without that.

When it comes to members of Congress, nobody did more than Summer Lee, who came across the state to be the first member to endorse Rabb, recruited others to join, and even brought her staff into it to help build his operation. Huge PA win for Lee.
